# Praetor Documentation Index
> Enterprise Fleet Governance, Repository-as-Code & Universal AI Agent Engineering Engine.

## Core Governance & Invariants
- [HISS-16 Formal Specification](standards/hiss-16-spec.md): Complete specification of HISS-01 through HISS-16 invariants.
- [Model Routing & Capacity Arbiter](standards/model-routing-and-fanout.md): Orchestration and fallback cascade for frontier and open models.
- [Agent Operating Harness](https://github.com/CordanaLLM/praetor/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Canonical single-source-of-truth instructions transpiled into vendor harnesses.
- [Archetype Authoring](guides/archetype-authoring.md): Archetype authoring, lattice joins, and profile manifests.
- [Developer Onboarding](guides/onboarding.md): Developer setup, Git hooks, and environment bootstrapping.
- [Architectural Decision Records](adr/README.md): ADR directory and architectural decision history.

## CLI Reference & Tooling
- [Fast Repository Adoption](adoption.md): 1-step repository onboarding via CLI (standardsctl adopt), MCP (standards_adopt), and GitHub Action bots.
- [Universal Dogfooding & Public Benchmarks](dogfooding.md): Self-governance auditing and dry-run benchmarking against non-owned public Git repositories.
- [Praetor CLI Reference](guides/cli-reference.md): Command usage and flags for praetorctl / standardsctl.
- [Branch Protection Ruleset](https://github.com/CordanaLLM/praetor/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json): Declarative GitHub ruleset for linear history and signed commits.

## Community & Funding
- [Polar.sh Issue Bounties](sponsoring.md): Feature bounties and contributor rewards split via Polar.sh MoR.
- [Monetization Strategy](monetization.md): In-IDE passive monetization (Idlen) and enterprise licensing framework.
